_README: EXEMPLAR (real-record mapping). This dossier structurally maps the EXISTING Acheron autopsy from engine/ledger/AGENT_AUTOPSIES.jsonl into SCHEMA.json to prove the schema ingests real records. It makes NO new scientific claims: every autopsy field is transcribed from the source record and disposition is left at NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE pending a real Necromancer pass. descendant_candidate is null (proposing one would be a new claim). Acheron is NOT the recommended first Necromancer target.

original_organism.premise: A coordinate-collision detector over Deep-Research reports surfaces registry collisions worth acting on.
original_organism.mechanism: Scan files; for each, emit a verdict artifact (collision_candidate on a hit, clean_scan otherwise).

measurements: ~569 artifacts total; ~73% of artifact mass is 1-bit clean verdicts
actual_consumers: registry reconciliation (collisions AA-031/AA-033 trace through it)
consumption_evidence: AGENT_AUTOPSIES.jsonl Acheron.evidence: artifact census by query

prior_verdicts: PROCESS_TABLE_2026-06-24.md: RETIRE-after-HITL (advisory, cited not trusted; LAW N11)
autopsy.kill_boundary: Transcribed from the autopsy's boundary_localization: the defect is in the EMISSION layer, not the detector. The autopsy explicitly records that the collision detector WORKED (58 candidates; headline registry collisions AA-031/AA-033 trace through its reconciliation). What the evidence kills is the one-artifact-per-1-bit-clean-verdict emission design, NOT the collision-detection premise.
surviving_claims: The collision-detection mechanism is compatible with the evidence (it produced actionable candidates).
The representation_hint (emit-on-signal + a single periodic coverage digest) is an untested repair, not a demonstrated one.
uncertainty: Whether a re-emitted Acheron would find NEW collisions or only re-derive the known AA-031/033 (not tested in this mapping).
Whether any live consumer remains for its output today (LAW N15 — not verified in this founding pass).
